results.title: ChatGPT Space | Create and collaborate with AI
results.content:
ChatGPT Space

# People and AI working together

Space helps you create living documents with ChatGPT and the people you work with. Keep work in one shared space, where you can tag in ChatGPT, Codex, or your dot to help—and build on shared context together. Collaborative slides and spreadsheets coming soon.

Available on Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans.

## Create, collaborate, and build together

Create, collaborate, and build together

### Powerful, self-updating pages

A new type of document built for work you do with agents—write, visualize, research, and code. Pages can stay updated from your connected tools, so you can focus on the work, not updating the doc.

### Work together with AI [...] ### Work together with AI

Edit pages with teammates in real time, leave feedback in comments, and tag ChatGPT or your dot to make changes or take on next steps—all in the same page.

### A home for shared knowledge

Bring your team’s files, pages, slides, spreadsheets, and more into one shared place. ChatGPT and your dot can use that context to help your team build on what’s already done.

## See what’s possible when ChatGPT is part of the team

See what’s possible when ChatGPT is part of the team

An onboarding prototype displayed on a shared page in Space, with teammate cursors and a sidebar.

### Visualize anything on a page [...] ### Visualize anything on a page

Visualize prototypes, research, data, or key decisions right on a page. Edit together with your team and tag ChatGPT, Codex, or your dot to work through changes.

### Collaborate on slides with your team and AI

Turn a conversation into slides using your team’s template. Edit with teammates, add feedback, and ask ChatGPT to revise the slides, keeping everyone working on the same deck.

Collaborative slides are coming soon.

### Shared context for your team and agents

Bring your team’s goals, plans, and designs into one shared space. Ask ChatGPT or your dot to keep dashboards updated, turn a teammate’s design into engineering tasks, or flag blockers. New work your team creates builds on shared context.

### A to-do list that updates itself

results.title: ChatGPT Space is Here: Create Pages, Share Files & Work with AI
results.content:
## ChatGPT Space gives users a shared home for files, Pages, and project context, while Pages provide editable documents that people and AI agents can work on together. OpenAI said that Spaces can be shared with teams, with access controlled through viewing and editing permissions.

Written By : Soham Halder

Reviewed By : Manisha Sharma

OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT beyond a traditional chat interface with the launch of Space, a shared workspace designed to bring people, files, and AI-assisted work into one place. OpenAI announced the feature at DevDay 2026 for users who need to create, organize, and collaborate without moving between multiple applications. [...] The system can handle tasks such as restructuring content, adding summaries, creating charts, and comparing information. Users can also leave comments on specific sections and ask ChatGPT to make targeted changes.

Pages are designed for collaboration as well. People with editing access can work on the same document in real time, while each collaborator can use their own ChatGPT to help with the shared content.

## AI Can Work from Shared Context

One of the biggest changes is how ChatGPT can use information already stored inside a Space. Teams can bring together files, pages and project information, giving ChatGPT more context when asked to research, update or build on existing work.
